metadata_hints.metric: Accuracy (%) = pass@1 averaged over 4 runs per problem (MathArena standard); answers are integers 0-999
metadata_hints.n_items_test: 30 problems (15 from AIME I held 2025-02-06 + 15 from AIME II held 2025-02-12)
metadata_hints.score_at_release_setting: MathArena, no tools, pass@1 averaged over 4 runs, AIME I+II combined; o3-mini (released 2025-01-31) was evaluated at exam time (Feb 2025). AIME I alone: o3-mini-high 80% reported 2025-02-10. Lab self-report: xAI Grok 3 (Think) 93.3% using cons@64 majority voting (2025-02-19), not standard pass@1.
metadata_hints.human_baseline: Mean about 6.2/15 (about 41%): AIME I mean 6.16 (n=4,690), AIME II mean 6.24 (n=1,518), median 6. MathArena: top 1% of human participants = 84.4%.
metadata_hints.lineage: Annual exam series used as rolling benchmarks: AIME 2024 (heavily used, contaminated) -> AIME 2025 -> AIME 2026. MathArena also runs HMMT, BRUMO, SMT, USAMO, IMO, Apex etc.
metadata_hints.known_contamination_or_defects: MathArena found 8 of the 30 AIME 2025 problems in similar form online before the exam (Math StackExchange, Quora, Wyzant; mostly easier problems; "do not affect the overall results"). Models scored 10-20 pp higher on AIME 2024 than on 2025, suggesting contamination of the 2024 set. Small N=30 (1 problem = 3.3 pp) gives high variance.

metadata_hints.metric: exact-match accuracy, averaged over the 23 tasks
metadata_hints.n_items_test: 6,511 examples across 23 tasks / 27 subtask files (max 250 examples per task, 3 exceptions); no train split (3 few-shot CoT exemplars per task provided)
metadata_hints.score_at_release_setting: 3-shot chain-of-thought prompting, average over 23 tasks (Codex answer-only 3-shot: 56.6). InstructGPT text-davinci-002 CoT 68.4 (answer-only 51.8); PaLM 540B CoT 65.2 (answer-only 52.3). Best prior BIG-Bench result on these tasks: 50.9
metadata_hints.lineage: Parent: BIG-Bench (2022-06, https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.04615); successor: BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH, Google DeepMind, 2025-02, https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19187), which replaces each BBH task citing saturation
metadata_hints.known_contamination_or_defects: BBEH authors state SOTA models reach near-perfect scores on many BBH tasks (saturation). No specific label-error audit found in sources reviewed
